department: Department of Civil, Geological and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants apply (with all documents) by March 31, 2027 for September 2027 entry; the domestic deadline is May 31. Incomplete applications are declined.
deadline.quote: Outcomes will be communicated to applicants approximately two months after the deadline. | International Deadline Fall Term September May 31 Documents due: May 31 March 31 Documents due: March 31

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to supervise you; apply only after a potential supervisor shows interest.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval is required to apply | This program requires you to have a supervisor.

funding.value: Most thesis-based engineering graduate students are funded; CAD 18,000-22,000/year for PhD; departmental awards are competitive and decided after admission.
funding.quote: Most thesis-based graduate students in the College of Engineering receive funding during their studies (e.g., scholarships, stipends, awards, research fellowships and teaching assistantships). | $18,000-$22,000/year (Ph.D.)

entry_route.value: A relevant master's degree (70%+) is required for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in an academic discipline relevant to the proposed field of study
